meta.name: Naam Namak Nishan
meta.description:
Naam Namak Nishan is a captivating series that follows the journey of cadets at the Officers Training Academy in Chennai. Through the eyes of Yuvraj Singh Chauhan and Gurbaz Singh Kahlon, viewers witness the evolution of their friendship as they navigate personal growth and forge strong bonds with fellow cadets, the show explores themes of unity, resilience, and the diverse tapestry of India.

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 14 Aug 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Juggernaut Productions · Network: Amazon miniTV

Complete series. On your server: S1 17/17

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Induction
videos.overview: Lt. General Vijay Raj Singh Chauhan's rousing Independence Day speech underscores the vital role of youth in modern warfare. His son, Yuvraj Singh Chauhan, heads to the Officers Training Academy (OTA), grappling with his father's high expectations. Simultaneously, the spirited Gurbaz Singh Kahlon embarks on his own journey to OTA, dealing with unique challenges. Their paths intersect humorously.

videos.title: The Challenge
videos.overview: Tensions escalate between Yuvi and Gurbaz at OTA. The episode begins with a heated confrontation where Gurbaz teases Yuvi, leading to a chase through their batch-mates. Yuvi’s diary, detailing his aspirations, almost falls into Gurbaz’s hands, intensifying their rivalry. The episode highlights their growing rivalry and the harsh realities of military training.

videos.title: Phoenix
videos.overview: The episode begins with Yuvi and Gurbaz facing the consequences of their rivalry, leading to a dramatic inspection by Cedric and Major Dushyant. Gurbaz's antics land him in trouble, but he cleverly avoids punishment, leaving Yuvi frustrated. The episode showcases the cadets' struggle to adapt to the strict discipline of the academy, highlighting their camaraderie and conflicts.

videos.title: The Onus
videos.overview: Tensions rise as Yuvi's platoon faces defeat in a crucial drill, leading to growing animosity between Yuvi and Gurbaz. Amidst the challenges Faiz demonstrates leadership by guiding Yuvi through the jungle. Gurbaz encounters the mysterious Nia, setting the stage for further developments as the characters navigate their personal conflicts and the looming threat of external dangers.

videos.title: Recognition
videos.overview: The story follows Gurbaz, a determined cadet aspiring to prove himself in the Olympic trials. Amidst personal challenges and the pressure of leadership, he confronts Yuvi, questioning his authority and vowing to become the Player of the Tournament. As tensions rise, relationships deepen, and pivotal decisions are made, the characters navigate their ambitions, fears, and the quest for recognition.

videos.title: High Stakes
videos.overview: In a high-stakes operation, Major Dev and his team attempt to thwart a group of perpetrators during a raid in Chennai, only to find that the criminals have managed to escape while deleting crucial data. Amidst the tension, emotional flashbacks reveal the bond between brothers Yuvi and Dev, highlighting their childhood memories and the strain in their relationship.

videos.title: Resilient Resolve
videos.overview: The episode shows the interaction between Yuvi and Dr. Tina as she tends to his injuries after a challenging basketball game. Yuvi is visibly affected by her presence, recalling their first encounter, while Dr. Tina remains professional and focused on her duties. The narrative also highlights the emotional struggles of his teammate Gurbaz, who grapples with feelings of guilt and shame.

videos.title: Friendship
videos.overview: The episode follows a tense narrative involving a shooter who infiltrates Talha's garage, showcasing his dangerous skills. Meanwhile, Dev working alone in his office, becomes embroiled in a mystery surrounding a woman's voice recording that hints at an impending threat. The story unfolds with emotional moments among characters like Gurbaz and Yuvi and the aftermath of Talha's death.

videos.title: Brotherhood
videos.overview: Yuvi and Gurbaz navigate their training challenges, including a balancing beam and swimming, while developing their friendship. Gurbaz struggles with self-doubt, particularly regarding his swimming abilities, leading to humorous situations as he tries to avoid the water. The episode culminates in a celebration of their camaraderie and growth, with a focus on teamwork and overcoming personal fears.

videos.title: Lucky Punch
videos.overview: Yuvi navigates his feelings for Dr. Tina while dealing with the pressures of an upcoming intra-company boxing competition that stirs painful memories. A Tribal Woman reveals a sinister plan, hinting at a larger conspiracy, as Faiz grapples with his commitments amidst rising tensions. The episode intertwines personal struggles with looming threats, setting the stage for dramatic confrontations.

videos.title: Backstabbed
videos.overview: In this episode, Yuvi faces off against his opponents in a boxing match, showcasing his growth and confidence through flashbacks of his training with Dev. As the competition unfolds, tensions rise among the cadets. The episode culminates in emotional moments as characters grapple with their feelings of pressure and disappointment amidst the competitive atmosphere.

videos.title: The Mole Within
videos.overview: The cadets navigate their social lives amidst military training showcasing camaraderie and personal struggles. Maya finds herself intrigued by Gurbaz while tensions rise between Vaishali and Swati. As the group prepares to celebrate Yuvi's birthday underlying conflicts and secrets come to light culminating in a contrast between their carefree moments and the serious implications of their training.

videos.title: Liberty Day
videos.overview: Gurbaz struggles with unrequited love, while Yuvi opens up to Dr. Tina about his feelings of inadequacy and betrayal. A mysterious subplot involving Maya Roy hints at hidden dangers. The episode culminates in a series of confrontations where Vaishali chooses her military career over a superficial relationship, and Yuvi learns of Nia's suicide attempt, leading him to rush to help Gurbaz.

videos.title: Misfire
videos.overview: Dev intensifies his investigation into the suspected mole, by hosting a party for the cadets. Where we see an attacked being implemented on him.

videos.title: The Gut Feeling
videos.overview: Dev investigates a mysterious theft at the OTA while hosting a casual party for the Kohima cadets, using it as a cover to identify a potential mole within the group. As tensions rise among the cadets, particularly between Yuvi and Dev, the episode delves into Swati’s emotional struggle with her father’s demands to abandon her military career.

videos.title: Honour Bound
videos.overview: Tensions rise as secrets are revealed and alliances are tested. We see Yuvi confronting Gurbaz about the suspicious object and later taking it to Dev only to be proven wrong once again. It is later revealed that Gurbaz past about his father is not entirely true. As a punishment to Yuvi on being disloyal to his company cadets is asked to be a substitute in the upcoming cricket tournament.

videos.title: Final Assault
videos.overview: In this intense season finale episode, tensions run high at the Officers Training Academy (OTA). We see how one of the cadets is held hostage. Dev coming to know about the plan of the terrorists comes to help the cadets after locating them. We see how the cadet using their training and knowledge to execute the mission of saving a fellow cadet who has been abducted.
